experiment: S3 Minimum Sufficient Observation Model Closure

disposition_policy.CORE: indispensable semantic primitive; must exist in the observation model
disposition_policy.EXPLANATORY: derived/display layer used to explain CORE facts; not a primitive
disposition_policy.DERIVED_REDUNDANT: mathematically derivable from another field, or semantically identical with zero added observation information (per §5 A/B)
disposition_policy.PROVISIONAL: retained but not yet verified; verdict inconclusive due to data/evidence limits
disposition_policy.UNRESOLVED: cannot be decided with current real data; explicit open slot

rule_5_note: No correlation-based dimension removal. Only (A) math-derivable or (B) semantic-identical-with-zero-added-info may be DERIVED_REDUNDANT. Different semantics stay distinct even if correlated.
